en.headline: Mark Six jackpot goes unclaimed in Saturday draw
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club draw returned numbers 12, 14, 20, 33, 34 and 37 with special number 31, leaving the first prize unwon and the next fund estimated at HK$28 million.
body: The Hong Kong Jockey Club held the 108th Mark Six draw of the year on Saturday evening, with the first-prize fund set at HK$20 million after the previous draw also went unclaimed.

The drawn numbers were 12, 14, 20, 33, 34 and 37, and the special number was 31. No ticket matched all six numbers for the top prize. There were 1.5 winning units for the second prize, each receiving HK$1,593,700, and 99 units for the third prize at HK$64,390 each. Total turnover reached HK$61,397,499, with overall prizes paid of about HK$19.2 million.

The next draw is scheduled for Tuesday 13 October, with the estimated first-prize fund at HK$28 million. Ticket sales for that draw close at 9.15pm. The Club operates the lottery, and a portion of proceeds supports the Lotteries Fund.

zh.headline: 周六六合彩頭獎無人中 下期基金估2800萬
zh.dek: 香港賽馬會周六攪珠，中獎號碼為12、14、20、33、34、37，特別號碼31，頭獎無人中，下期估計頭獎基金達2800萬港元。
body: 香港賽馬會於周六晚上舉行今年第108期六合彩攪珠，由於上期頭獎無人中，本期頭獎基金定為2000萬港元。
攪出號碼為12、14、20、33、34及37，特別號碼為31。頭獎無人中。二獎有1.5注中，每注派彩1,593,700港元；三獎有99注中，每注派彩64,390港元。總投注額達61,397,499港元，整體派彩約1920萬港元。
下一期攪珠定於下周二（10月13日）舉行，估計頭獎基金達2800萬港元。該期售票於晚上9時15分截止。賽馬會營運六合彩，部分收益撥入獎券基金。
